## This file specifies modifiers to include in a fwl file generated by MakeFwl
## Lines beginning with # are comments

## Specify a preset. This establishes the baseline for all other modifiers.
## Options: easy, normal, hard, hardcore, casual, hammer, immersive
preset = normal

###############################################################################
## Customization
## These settings will override the preset if they exist. Remove the # from the
## front of a line to enable the customization. Otherwise, the default from the
## preset will be used.
###############################################################################

## Combat difficulty. This affects player damage, enemy damage and enemy speed.
## Options: veryeasy, easy, normal, hard, veryhard
#combat = normal

## Death penalty. This affects item and skill loss from dying in the game.
## Options: casual, veryeasy, easy, normal, hard, hardcore
#deathpenalty = normal

## Resource rate. Affects the amount of resources collected by players.
## Options: muchless, less, normal, more, muchmore, most
#resources = normal

## Raid rate. Affects how often player bases are raided.
## Options: none, muchless, less, normal, more, muchmore
#raids = normal

## Portals. Affects how portals function.
## Options: casual, normal, hard, veryhard
#portals = normal

###############################################################################
## Optional Flags
## These are additional toggles available in the game. Remove the # from the
## front of a line to enable the option. Otherwise, the default from the preset
## will be used. Each option can be set to true (enabled) or false (disabled).
###############################################################################

## Build pieces require no materials to build.
#nobuildcost = false

## Raids are based on the progress of each player, rather than the server
#playerevents = false

## Wood can catch fire and burn anywhere in the world, not only Ashlands
#fire = false

## Enemies will not attack unless provoked
#passivemobs = false

## Players will not have access to the map or minimap
#nomap = false
